drug_class: ACE Inhibitor combined with a Thiazide Diuretic (water pill)
purpose: This medication is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension). It combines two medicines in one tablet to help lower your blood pressure more effectively. Keeping your blood pressure under control helps reduce your risk of heart attack, stroke, and kidney problems.
how_it_works: Lisinopril works by relaxing and widening your blood vessels, making it easier for your heart to pump blood. Hydrochlorothiazide is a water pill that helps your kidneys remove extra salt and fluid from your body, which also lowers blood pressure. Together, these two medicines team up to bring your blood pressure down more effectively than either one alone.
common_side_effects: You may notice dizziness, especially when standing up quickly, a dry nagging cough, headache, or feeling tired. Some people experience increased urination because of the water pill. Low potassium levels can also occur, which may cause muscle cramps or weakness.
warnings: Do NOT take this medicine if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant, as it can cause serious harm to an unborn baby. Tell your doctor right away if you notice swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat, as this can be a rare but dangerous allergic reaction called angioedema. Avoid taking potassium supplements or salt substitutes without asking your doctor first. Let your doctor know if you have kidney or liver problems before taking this medication.
typical_dosing: The usual starting dose is one tablet taken by mouth once a day. Your doctor may adjust your dose based on how your blood pressure responds. It is best to take it at the same time each day, with or without food. Do not stop taking it suddenly without talking to your doctor first.
